thread:
paul: Observed SSE garbling in onboarding sampleapp when short-lived tokens refresh mid-stream. Small repro included.

anya: Node 18 or browser? which SDK?

paul: Node 18, sampleapp v0.4.0, js-sdk 1.6.0. Token TTL ~25s. Sequence: client notices 401, swaps token and reconnects. Occasionally fragments get stitched so delimiters split, causing JSON.parse errors.

paul: Raw capture:```
data: {"n":1,"t":"hi"}\n\n:data: keepalive\ndata: {"n":2,"t":"there"}\n\n```

paul: On reconnect we sometimes see `:data: keepalive\ndata:` merged into one chunk. Parser emits half-messages.

toni: Likely leftover bytes from old socket + immediate new socket. Two quick fixes: 1) SDK should buffer until `\n\n` boundary before emit, 2) send Last-Event-ID on reconnect so server resumes cleanly. Also debounce concurrent refreshes to avoid interleaving.

anya: I'll add buffering and drop single-colon comment lines before JSON.parse in the sampleapp. Toni, can you add Last-Event-ID support to the socket reconstructor?
